ordering_contract: Ordinary nonhistorical natural questions can receive bounded explicitly unassociated project originals despite soft lexical mismatch; unknown soft subjects gain no asserted association.
Stored/completed user custody remains original observation with unknown applicability, no revived workflow. Whole-source canonical representation scopes remain bound to their original metadata.
Existing custody read defaults are unchanged. recent_context reads latest<=16 whole consumed user sources <=600 chars, without extra Store.get body fetch.

The direct neutral custody window is additional to existing query-filtered snapshot custody: existing snapshots return<=8 rows per candidate query (<=8 hard-scoped query windows), with the legacy subject-free fallback only when permitted. These are finite separate pools, not a claim of16 total custody reads.

Neutral user allocation selects<=2 complete originals with latest/earliest boundary diversity; sequence is capture order, never event identity/time. Allocation <=min(1800,budget//3) after protected whole executions/reports.

Each assistant/tool role can use one query-filtered window and one neutral window, each <=16 candidates and <=2 returned; their union is <=32 candidate selections and <=4 unique returned originals per role. The added neutral window reads <=1200 source-body chars per candidate. Oversized/invalid captures are omitted whole; legacy query-filtered source reading is unchanged.
Novel complete source groups compete before duplicate qualifier-only wrappers. Scope/current/history/uncertainty associations are not merged or transferred.

Whole command/output/exit capture groups remain atomic. Independent small report protection no longer depends on grammatical question wording. Additional original-role context precedes repeated inferred prose.
Explicit original-operation present assessments use the earliest bounded capture window while retaining operation topic; historical/as-of queries retain prior guards.
Public second rendering is idempotent at600/1400/2900/6000 and selected/omitted user-context counts equal delivered source wrappers.
limits: Source visibility is not answer quality or semantic truth; no model answers or grades were regenerated.
Seven R13 and four R12 required full spans remain outside bounded delivered contexts; all per-fact strict/mirror/incidental gains and losses stay in each replay.
Unknown-soft-topic neutral transport is an explicit product contract change; prior test bytes and old red expectations are preserved in transport-contract-regressions/before.
Central full suite, architecture/docs updates and independent source reviews are required before native calls.
